name: Documented center of Site 04, Shackleton rim
coordinate_note: The report publishes Site04 (Shackleton Rim) at -89.7668°, -171.87°. The longitude is normalized to 188.13° east for the Horizons geodetic query.
dem_version: LOLA polar LDEM at 5 m/pixel, Site04; version published at NASA/GSFC PGDA
dem_projection: South polar stereographic, X/Y coordinates in meters; MOON_ME frame, DE421 ephemeris (according to NASA/GSFC PGDA)
dem_vertical_reference: The product defines Z as surface height in meters; the GeoTIFF does not declare any other explicit vertical datum. For Horizons, Z is assumed to be relative to the mean lunar radius of 1,737,400 m.
